subject.title: Feishu: @mention not recognized in group when multiple bots share the same group (open_id app-scoped mismatch)

question: Should the Feishu plugin support multi-bot mention matching by adding a cross-app identity resolver, or document this Feishu setup as unsupported until a stable Feishu identifier is proven?
rationale: Current source confirms the bug path, but the known proposed union_id fix depends on Feishu API fields that the issue says are not available from the startup bot info endpoint.

options.title: Require API-proven Feishu identity fix
options.body: Keep this issue open and require the linked implementation to prove a stable identifier or cross-app open_id mapping with focused tests and live/API evidence before merge.

options.title: Document unsupported setup
options.body: Close or narrow the issue only if maintainers decide multiple Feishu bot apps in one group cannot be reliably supported with available Feishu APIs.

recommendation.title: Require API-proven Feishu identity fix
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require the linked implementation to prove a stable identifier or cross-app open_id mapping with focused tests and live/API evidence before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu plugin metadata names this handle as the community-maintained ownership signal, making them the best available product/API decision owner.
